items.q: I am proud to say that I got to know him so well that me and my wife met him and his wife Lucille quite often whenever they came to Paris.

ctx.x: And when I got to know him as well as I did, and listened to so much of his horn playing, my admiration of him grew more and more. I am proud to say that I got to know him so well that me and my wife met him and his wife Lucille quite often whenever they came to Paris.

Louis, who was also known as Gate-Mouth, then Satchel-Mouth, which was shortened to Gate, Satchmo and was also called Pops, was a genius. He gave much to the jazz world with his original style of trumpet playing and jazz singing. There has been quite a few geniuses in jazz music after Satchmo, but many of them died young. But the world was fortunate to have had it's Louis, Pops, Gatemouth, Satchmo Armstrong for so many happy trumpet and singing years! He did so very much for jazz and to bring joys to the world of…

Charlie Shavers' death was a shocking surprise to me, and Lily, because we had not heard that he was sick. It was the passing of two great trumpet men within a few days of each other, because Charlie was a great trumpet player and musician who was also an arranger I knew Charlie quite well because I was living in New York when he made his real debut with the John Kirby orchestra.
